title: Cloudways MCP Server: What It Does and How to Set It Up
excerpt: Cloudways lets AI tools such as Claude and Cursor manage your servers in plain language. Here is what it can do, how to connect it in three steps and how to stay safe.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Cloudways MCP Server: What It Does, How to Set Up
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Cloudways MCP server guide: what it can do, how to connect Claude, Cursor or VS Code in three steps, what you need, and how to use it safely.
meta.rl_answer: Cloudways MCP lets AI tools manage your Cloudways servers. Set it up with an access token and test on a spare server first.
meta.rl_faqs:
What is the Cloudways MCP server? | It lets MCP-compatible AI tools run actions on your Cloudways servers from plain-language requests.
Which AI tools work with Cloudways MCP? | Cloudways lists Claude, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini CLI and Codex, among others.
How do I connect Cloudways MCP? | Get an access token, add https://mcp.cloudways.com/mcp/ with the X-Access-Token and X-Mcp-Host headers, then ask for your server list.
Is the Cloudways API key method still supported? | Cloudways says the API key method is deprecated by 15 October 2026. Use an access token.
Is Cloudways MCP safe to use? | Its tools include deleting servers. Start with a test server and read-only requests.
meta.rl_sources:
Cloudways support: how to use the Cloudways MCP server | https://support.cloudways.com/en/articles/14654372-how-to-use-cloudways-mcp-server-for-ai-based-server-management

meta.rl_takeaways:
The MCP server lets AI tools manage your Cloudways servers in plain language.
Setup is three steps: credentials, client configuration, a test request.
Use an access token. The API key method is deprecated by 15 October 2026.
Start with a test server, because the tools include deleting servers.
meta.rl_g_glossary:
MCP | A standard way for AI tools to connect to other software.
Access token | A key that proves who you are to a service.
MCP client | An AI tool that can connect to MCP servers.
Staging | A private copy of a site for testing.
